context: Evaluates correct usage of the Zod-based node schemas from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must use WallNode.parse(), LevelNode.parse(), AnyNode.parse() and related schema constructors to create and validate nodes, rely on auto-generated IDs, and work with discriminated union parsing.

checklist.name: WallNode.parse usage
checklist.description: Calls WallNode.parse({ start, end, ... }) to produce a valid WallNode with an auto-generated ID prefixed 'wall_'.

checklist.name: LevelNode.parse usage
checklist.description: Calls LevelNode.parse({ level: n }) to produce a valid LevelNode with an auto-generated ID prefixed 'level_'.

checklist.name: BaseNode defaults
checklist.description: Verifies that parsed nodes have object set to 'node', visible defaulting to true, and parentId defaulting to null without explicitly providing those fields.

checklist.name: AnyNode discriminated union
checklist.description: Uses AnyNode.parse() on raw objects to parse them through the discriminated union on the 'type' field, producing correctly typed nodes.

checklist.name: Validation error handling
checklist.description: Handles or demonstrates Zod validation errors when AnyNode.parse() receives an unsupported type, without crashing silently.
